headlines.text: Flash back to 2025, when a new champion was crowned for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as FTR vs. Brodido battled it out, appearing on Full Gear, rated 8.73 ? a match fans still talk about ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. It marked FTR's 20th match with the title on the line. FTR dethroned Brodido for the AEW World Tag Team Championship in a hard-hitting battle between two of the promotion's best tag teams.

That Wednesday in 2023, Jon Moxley vs. Mark Briscoe met in a Continental Classic League Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.60 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle, part of the special Thanksgiving Eve '23 card.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Nyla Rose returned to the fold after 6 weeks away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2025, when a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Mark Briscoe vs. Kyle Fletcher battled it out in a No DQ match, appearing on Full Gear, rated 9.00 ? an outstanding performance from both sides ? ending the champion's reign at 9 defenses. It was the 120th time the AEW TNT Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. Mark Briscoe dethroned Kyle Fletcher for the TNT Championship in a brutal No Disqualification match, the stipulation itself born from Briscoe's refusal to join the Don Callis Family if he lost.

On a Saturday in 2025, back when a new chapter began as Ricochet vs. Bobby Lashley vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Kevin Knight vs. Mark Davis vs. Matt Menard vs. Mike Bailey vs. Orange Cassidy vs. Roderick Strong vs. Shelton Benjamin vs. Wheeler Yuta fought for the brand-new AEW National Title in a Casino Gauntlet match, appearing on Full Gear, rated 7.33 ? a solid showing. Ricochet outlasted a stacked 12-man Casino Gauntlet field ? including Lashley, Castagnoli, Garcia, Knight, Davis, Menard, Bailey, Cassidy, Strong, Benjamin and Yuta ? to become the inaugural AEW National Champion.

Flash back to 2025, when the inaugural CMLL World Trios Titles was crowned as El Sky Team vs. Hechicero, Okada & Takeshita went to war, appearing on Full Gear, rated 6.74. El Sky Team's M?stico hit La M?stica on Hechicero to retain the CMLL World Trios Championship, capitalizing on a shocking mid-match betrayal when Okada turned on his own Don Callis Family partner Takeshita.
